settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_AUTH_MODE
settings.description: How the operator APIs verify a PingFederate access token: jwt, against PingFederate's keys, or introspection, by asking its introspection endpoint (RFC 7662)

when_wrong.detail: Neither jwt nor introspection: every operator request is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_AUDIENCE
settings.description: The audience an operator access token must carry in aud: the value of the access token manager's audience (a JWT manager's Audience Claim Value, or an aud attribute on a reference manager)

when_wrong.detail: Unset: every operator request is a 503, in either profile, because no token can be checked for its audience

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_BASE_URL
settings.description: The origin operators address the operator APIs at, with no path (https://pf.example.com): a DPoP proof's htu must be this followed by the request's path, never a URL built from the Host header

when_wrong.detail: Unset, not an origin, or http under the production profile: every operator request is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_JWKS_URL
settings.description: PingFederate's JWKS for the access token manager's signing keys (https://pf.example.com/pf/JWKS for the central signing key), in jwt mode

when_wrong.detail: Unset in jwt mode: every operator request is a 503; unreachable: a 503 once the keys held are 20 minutes old

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_ACCESS_TOKEN_TYP
settings.description: The typ header PingFederate's JWT access token manager puts on its tokens (its Type Header Value), in jwt mode: at+jwt or application/at+jwt as RFC 9068 asks, the default; none for a manager whose field is blank, which then requires the header to be missing; or another value, compared exactly

when_wrong.detail: Not the manager's value: every operator request in jwt mode is a 401 invalid_token

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
settings.description: PingFederate's introspection endpoint (https://pf.example.com/as/introspect.oauth2), in introspection mode

when_wrong.detail: Unset in introspection mode: every operator request is a 503; unreachable: a 503

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The client the operator APIs introspect tokens as (client_secret_basic); it needs the Access Token Validation grant

when_wrong.detail: Unset in introspection mode: every operator request is a 503; wrong: PingFederate answers 401 and every operator request is a 503
Unset in introspection mode: every operator request is a 503; wrong: every operator request is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the JWKS and introspection calls, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_AUTH_FAILURES_PER_MINUTE
settings.description: How many failed authentications one client address may make in a minute before every operator request from it is a 429 until the minute ends

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 up: every operator request is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_OPERATOR_MUTATIONS_PER_MINUTE
settings.description: How many changes one operator (the token's subject) may make in a minute before the next is a 429 until the minute ends

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 up: every operator request is a 503
